definitions.explanation: A formal notice or document submitted to authorities or organizations.
The delivery of goods to a customer. In this sense the word almost always takes the polite prefix お-, especially in business use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
⟦{欠席届|けっせきとどけ}→欠席届：08080_kessekitodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: I handed the absence notification to the teacher.

examples.japanese: お{届|とど}け{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{届|とど}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日後|みっかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The item will be delivered in three days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{届|とど}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません→申し訳ございません：18087_moushiwakegozaimasen⟧。
examples.english: We apologize that your newspaper was delivered late.

notes:
COMMON DOCUMENT TYPES:
- ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ - marriage registration
- {出生届|しゅっせいとどけ} - birth registration
- ⟦{死亡届|しぼうとどけ}→死亡届：25769_shiboutodoke⟧ - death registration
- ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧ - resignation notice
- ⟦{転居届|てんきょとどけ}→転居届：10284_tenkyotodoke⟧ - change of address notification
- ⟦{欠席届|けっせきとどけ}→欠席届：08080_kessekitodoke⟧ - absence notification
- {不在届|ふざいとどけ} - notice of absence

FORMS:
- ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧ - notification, registration (more formal)
- {届|とど}ける - to deliver, to report (verb)
- ⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ - to reach, to arrive (intransitive verb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {届|とど}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ - to submit a notification
- {届|とど}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ - to receive a report

USAGE:
When used as a suffix (⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧, etc.), it refers to official documents. In the delivery sense (sense 2), the word is almost always お{届|とど}け, a polite form used by shops and delivery services: お{届|とど}け{先|さき} (delivery address), お{届|とど}け{日|び} (delivery date).
